objective: Diagnosticar en solo lectura el bloqueo RuntimeError del detail backfill ISCAM de ESTELAR 05/07/2026. Identificar tickets con encabezado cero y detalle no cero, deltas relevantes encabezado vs lineas, lineas negativas y variantes FRANQICIA/FRANQUICIA antes de cualquier reintento.

queries.name: estelar_ticket_anomalies_20260705
queries.sql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT ch.folio, ch.fecha,
         CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS encabezado
  FROM cheques ch WITH (NOLOCK)
  INNER JOIN turnos tr WITH (NOLOCK) ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno
  WHERE tr.apertura >= '2026-07-05 09:00:00'
    AND tr.apertura <  '2026-07-06 09:00:00'
    AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0
),
d AS (
  SELECT h.folio,
         MAX(h.fecha) AS fecha,
         MAX(h.encabezado) AS encabezado,
         CAST(SUM(CAST(ISNULL(cd.cantidad,0)*ISNULL(cd.precio,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS decimal(19,4)) AS productos,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(cd.cantidad,0)*ISNULL(cd.precio,0) < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lineas_negativas,
         SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(ISNULL(p.descripcion,'')) LIKE '%FRANQ%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lineas_franq
  FROM h
  LEFT JOIN cheqdet cd WITH (NOLOCK) ON cd.foliodet=h.folio
  LEFT JOIN productos p WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.idproducto=cd.idproducto
  GROUP BY h.folio
)
SELECT folio, fecha, encabezado, productos,
       CAST(encabezado-productos AS decimal(19,4)) AS delta,
       lineas_negativas, lineas_franq
FROM d
WHERE (encabezado=0 AND ABS(productos)>0.05)
   OR ABS(encabezado-productos)>0.05
   OR lineas_negativas>0
   OR lineas_franq>0
ORDER BY ABS(encabezado-productos) DESC, folio

queries.name: estelar_suspicious_ticket_lines_20260705
queries.sql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT ch.folio, ch.fecha,
         CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS encabezado
  FROM cheques ch WITH (NOLOCK)
  INNER JOIN turnos tr WITH (NOLOCK) ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno
  WHERE tr.apertura >= '2026-07-05 09:00:00'
    AND tr.apertura <  '2026-07-06 09:00:00'
    AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0
),
d AS (
  SELECT h.folio,
         MAX(h.fecha) AS fecha,
         MAX(h.encabezado) AS encabezado,
         CAST(SUM(CAST(ISNULL(cd.cantidad,0)*ISNULL(cd.precio,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS decimal(19,4)) AS productos
  FROM h
  LEFT JOIN cheqdet cd WITH (NOLOCK) ON cd.foliodet=h.folio
  GROUP BY h.folio
),
s AS (
  SELECT folio FROM d
  WHERE (encabezado=0 AND ABS(productos)>0.05)
     OR ABS(encabezado-productos)>0.05
)
SELECT d.folio, d.fecha, d.encabezado, d.productos,
       CAST(d.encabezado-d.productos AS decimal(19,4)) AS delta,
       cd.idproducto, p.descripcion,
       CAST(ISNULL(cd.cantidad,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS cantidad,
       CAST(ISNULL(cd.precio,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS precio,
       CAST(ISNULL(cd.cantidad,0)*ISNULL(cd.precio,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS importe_linea
FROM d
INNER JOIN s ON s.folio=d.folio
LEFT JOIN cheqdet cd WITH (NOLOCK) ON cd.foliodet=d.folio
LEFT JOIN productos p WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.idproducto=cd.idproducto
ORDER BY d.folio, cd.idproducto
